preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call callget() function
Any victim address must have BOND token balance > 0

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the callget() function to transfer BOND tokens from any victim address to your own address without requiring approval. The function lacks access control checks beyond ownership and doesn't validate that the owner has permission to transfer other users' tokens. Simply call callget(victim_address, attacker_address, amount) where victim_address has sufficient BOND balance.
